skill.summary: Protect your personal data when using AI tools — practical privacy hygiene.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of "Data Privacy in the AI Era" — a practical privacy hygiene guide for AI tool users.

- Explains how AI tools collect, store, and use user data, with emphasis on risks and provider differences.
- Provides a clear, comprehensive list of sensitive information never to enter into AI services.
- Offers actionable privacy practices: anonymizing inputs, managing chat history, and reviewing tool settings.
- Guides users on reading and evaluating AI privacy policies, with practical tips for red flags and updates.
- Includes tailored privacy checklists and encourages verification with official documentation.
- Refuses to process or store user credentials or illegal information; offers only general educational guidance.
